newsitem.title: SPAIN: Doctor, teachers among Barcelona child-sex arrests.
newsitem.headline: Doctor, teachers among Barcelona child-sex arrests.

text.p: A headmaster, schoolteachers, a doctor and a local politician have been arrested in Barcelona on suspicion of involvement in a child prostitution ring with children as young as five, Spanish state radio said on Tuesday.
It quoted sources close to the investigation as saying at least 40 children, aged five to 14, had been abused in Cuitat Vella, one of the poorest districts of the Catalan capital.
"There are a number of people in prison suspected of participating directly in the events...We are in the initial phase of the investigation," Judge Josep Niubo told reporters.
He declared the legal proceedings secret and declined to give a figure for the number of people in detention.
Media reports put the total arrested over the past week at 11, including a school headmaster, teachers, a doctor and owners of apartments used for child prostitution.
A spokeswoman for the Barcelona municipality said a Socialist Party official from Ciutat Vella was among those arrested. He was stripped of his position on Tuesday and expelled from the party.
Police said most of the parents did not know their children were involved in prostitution though some might have done.
Police also found photographs and videos of paedophiles in sex acts with the children, state television reported. It said the videos were sold for up to 1.0 million pesetas ($6,700) each.
Members of a neighbourhood association in Ciutat Vella said police had shown them some of the videos.

One member, Carme Gimenez, told reporters with tears in her eyes that she had seen very young children, some only five, being abused by men and women in the videos. Some of the adults covered their faces but others were identifiable, she added.
Sources close to the case were quoted as saying the videos also showed children receiving gifts and money for sex in a municipal recreation centre for children in the district.
The director of the centre was among those detained and had a prior arrest on similar charges, Spanish media said.

The daily El Pais said police uncovered the first clue to the ring when they arrested a couple in June who rented out their 10-year-old son as a prostitute at weekends for 30,000 pesetas ($200). The family lived in Ciutat Vella.
The parents, who were reported to have sometimes received payment in alcoholic beverages, were freed on probation last week.
